nodes.label: desktop memory - NVIDIA NIM as the one transport

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. NVIDIA NIM is the one transport for every model call in v3 - the shared generator, the dense embedder and the judge all POST through v3/nim.py. Terms, to be verified against the dashboard because they change: the OpenAI-compatible endpoint https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1 with key NVIDIA_API_KEY; forever-free as of May 2026 with the old credit caps removed, so cost is not the constraint; and the constraint is rate, at 40 requests per minute, upgradable to 200 on request. Models: the generator and RAGAS judge are qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b, one model injected into all three arms and reused as the judge, multilingual so HERB now and the deferred Swedish Bonnier set later run on the same model - with reasoning disabled by appending /no_think to the prompt plus temperature=0, and a hard warning NOT to use chat_template_kwargs={"enable_thinking": False}, because that soft switch breaks guided and structured JSON on SGLang, returning empty or garbled non-JSON about one time in five; and the embedder is nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2, multilingual including Swedish, 8192-token context, asymmetric. Rate-limiting is a shared thread-safe pacer in nim.py where every call and every retry across all threads claims the next evenly-spaced slot under one lock, with SECONDS_BETWEEN_CALLS setting the pace and a 1.5s floor as the 40/min ceiling, keeping 429 Retry-After and exponential backoff as a loud backstop rather than the primary control. Multi-account key-stacking for higher RPM is rejected as a terms violation and an integrity liability
